meta.name: deck-hermes-cyber
meta.description: 黑底 + CRT 网格扫描线 + $ 命令行标题 + 薄荷绿大字 + 三档 tag

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为终端生成赛博朋克风格的个人名片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让终端名片有赛博朋克视觉风格。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a cyberpunk-style personal card for your terminal.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a cyberpunk visual style for your terminal card.

howto.what: 把幻灯片套上终端测评模板:黑底加网格扫描线和 CRT 暗角,窗口用红绿灯和 $ 命令行标题,正文是薄荷绿等宽大字,配描边柱状图和闪烁光标,并用琥珀/绿/红三档标签。适合做 CLI、agent 或开发工具的测评页。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作 CLI 工具、agent 或开发工具的测评演示文稿,或索要「终端风」幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 用 Cyber Terminal Deck 给 git-cliff 做个测评演示
say.note: 会生成带终端样式的测评幻灯片。

say.text: 把这两次跑分的 diff 做成薄荷绿终端风幻灯片
say.note: 会生成带闪烁光标和红绿灯窗口的页面。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude applies this deck template to review developer tools. Slides get a near-black background with cyber grid and CRT vignette, window traffic-light chrome with a '$' prompt title, mint-green large monospace text, stroke-only bar charts, blinking cursor, and amber/green/red tags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a slide deck to review a CLI tool, agent, or developer tool, especially with terminal aesthetics or content such as trace, diff, benchmark.

say_en.text: Make a review deck for git-cliff with Cyber Terminal Deck
say_en.note: Produces a slide with the terminal-style layout.

say_en.text: Make one review slide for this CLI tool with trace and benchmark
say_en.note: Displays results with the three tag colors and bar chart.

say_en.text: Turn this diff into mint-green terminal-style slides
say_en.note: Adds the blinking cursor and traffic-light window frame.
